title: Accounts merge
statementMd:
Each account is `[name, email1, email2, ...]`. Accounts belong to the same person if they share an email. Return merged accounts as `[name, sorted unique emails...]`, with the whole list sorted by name then by the email list.

**Example:** `accounts_merge([["John", "a@x", "b@x"], ["John", "b@x", "c@x"], ["Mary", "…)` returns `[["John", "a@x", "b@x", "c@x"], ["Mary", "m@x"]]`.
